narrative.overview: Selom is a dark multi-omics IDE built so a bench scientist can turn raw data into a publication-quality figure. The whole interface is a dark, calm workspace on which one thing glows: the figure, rendered on a light #ffffff artboard floating in the dark shell. The single accent is a luminous cyan that behaves like a status light on lab equipment — it marks what is live, selected, or actionable, and nothing else. It explicitly rejects the AI bio-tool reflex: purple-on-black gradients, neon glassmorphism, hero-metric templates.
keyCharacteristics: Dark blue-black shell; the figure is the only bright surface, always on a light artboard.
One accent — cyan — used as a status light, never as decoration.
Depth from hairline borders + tonal layering, not shadows.
Tabular mono numerals wherever a number is shown.
Confident product density: small type, calm spacing, no choreography.

rules.name: The Status-Light Rule
rules.body: Cyan is a signal, not a paint. It appears on ≤10% of any screen — primary action, current selection, focus, live state. If cyan is making something 'pop,' remove it.

rules.name: The Light-Artboard Rule
rules.body: A figure is always rendered on the #ffffff artboard with #0f172a ink, even though the app is dark. Never render publication data on a dark surface.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a #1e2a3a hairline or a tonal step before a shadow. A drop-shadow on a panel is almost always wrong here.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: The cyan glow belongs to primary actions and the brand mark only. Never glow a card or secondary button for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any digit a user might compare or watch change is set in Geist Mono with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The One-Sans Rule
rules.body: Geist Sans owns all prose and UI; the only permitted second family is Geist Mono, for data only.

dos: Do keep cyan to ≤10% of any screen — primary action, current selection, focus, live state.
Do render every figure on the light #ffffff artboard with #0f172a ink, even in the dark app.
Do separate surfaces with a hairline or tonal step before reaching for a shadow.
Do set every number in Geist Mono tabular-nums.
Do use near-white ink for body copy; reserve slate for secondary/label text and verify ≥4.5:1 contrast.
Do surface statistical guardrails as amber warn badges before a figure.
donts: Don't use cyan as decoration or glow static containers for atmosphere.
Don't render publication data on a dark surface.
Don't ship the AI bio-tool reflex: purple-on-black gradients, neon glassmorphism, gradient text, hero-metric templates.
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't introduce a display or serif font.
Don't nest cards or default to a modal.
